attempts.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (initial primary), node2, node3 (standbys) on RHEL 10, generating the replicator credential on node1 and distributing it node-to-node over SSH (never printed). Verified live replication, then exercised failover: stopped node1, promoted node2 to writable primary with zero committed-data loss, reparented node3 to stream from node2, and re-provisioned node1 as a standby of node2 via pg_basebackup. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time node-restart protocol on all three nodes (node1, node3, then primary node2 last), proving changed OS boot IDs and full PostgreSQL/replication recovery (including node2 correctly resuming as primary and both standbys auto-reattaching) after each restart, with a final end-to-end write replicated to both standbys.
